hypothesis: Token-processing volume may explain the text-dependent execution paths better than character counts. A lexical token estimate leaves a separate feature available for the alternating special-token branch.

pcvs.name: default_tokenization
pcvs.rationale: Separates the initial call and its initialization work.

pcvs.expression: 0 if prompts.gi_frame.f_locals.get('tokenization_kwargs') is None else sum((t.count(' ') + 1 + t.count('.') + t.count(',') + t.count('-') + 2 * t.count('epsilon') + t.count('zeta') + t.count(' eta') + 2 * t.count('Distinguish') + t.count('Explain') for p in prompts.gi_frame.f_locals['.0'].gi_frame.f_locals['self'].iterable for t in [p['prompt'] if 'prompt' in p else p]))
pcvs.name: estimated_prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Estimates token-processing volume using word boundaries, punctuation, and likely subword splits in the supplied texts, without running the tokenizer.

pcvs.name: special_token_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional processing when tokenization inserts special tokens.
